description: Nokhada Workbench factor library. Only factors read from the official source are marked cited. UAE grid electricity and district cooling have no default: the user supplies a value and its source.

factors.label: Diesel (100% mineral diesel)
factors.gas_basis: kg CO2e per unit: CO2, CH4 and N2O combined, GWP100 from IPCC AR5 (DESNZ 2025 methodology paper, Table 1)
factors.source_title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2025. Flat file, Fuels > Liquid fuels > Diesel (100% mineral diesel), litres, kg CO2e (factor ID 1_101_1012_8_1)
factors.notes: Default for diesel and generator diesel. UK factor for fuel with no biofuel blended in; confirm it suits your fuel with your verifier.
factors.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ), UK Government

factors.label: Diesel (average biofuel blend)
factors.gas_basis: kg CO2e per unit: CO2, CH4 and N2O combined, GWP100 from IPCC AR5 (DESNZ 2025 methodology paper, Table 1)
factors.source_title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2025. Flat file, Fuels > Liquid fuels > Diesel (average biofuel blend), litres, kg CO2e (factor ID 1_101_1011_8_1)
factors.notes: UK forecourt average, which includes biodiesel. Use only if your fuel contains a similar blend.
